classes.name: results
classes.reason: probe.write_staged does open/write/fsync/close inline and its create_ns/write_ns/fsync_ns are timed, so the rank stalls until the data is durable, while other ranks are concurrently writing their own r%d files and only meet at the per-generation barrier.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: probe.write_buffered writes and closes with no fsync and no timing collected, so the 4 KiB payload is left to the page cache and overlaps subsequent loop work rather than stalling the rank, and each rank writes only into its own r%d path.
